mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(cs.name, 20) FROM callstack cs WHERE cs.name LIKE 'H:CJTHREAD_CJThread%' AND cs.ts - #{offset} + cs.dur >= #{startTime} AND cs.ts - #{offset} <= #{endTime} AND cs.name NOT LIKE 'H:CJTHREAD_CJThreadSetName%' AND cs.dur IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(cs.name, 20) as state, #{cjThreadId} as cjThreadId, ts - #{offset} as startTime, ts - #{offset} + dur as endTime, dur as duration, p.pid as processId, th.tid as threadId FROM callstack cs LEFT JOIN thread AS th ON th.id = cs.parent_id LEFT JOIN process AS p ON th.ipid = p.ipid WHERE cs.cookie = #{cjThreadId} and cs.name LIKE 'H:CJTHREAD_CJThread%' AND cs.ts - #{offset} + cs.dur >= #{startTime} AND cs.ts - #{offset} <= #{endTime} AND cs.name NOT LIKE 'H:CJTHREAD_CJThreadSetName%' AND cs.dur IS NOT NULL

SELECT cs.cookie as cjThreadId, SUBSTR(c.name, INSTR(name, ' ') + 1) as cjThreadName, pid as processId FROM (SELECT DISTINCT cookie, pid FROM callstack cs LEFT JOIN thread AS th ON th.id = cs.parent_id LEFT JOIN process AS p ON th.ipid = p.ipid WHERE cs.name LIKE 'H:CJTHREAD_%' AND ts - #{offset} + dur >= #{startTime} AND ts - #{offset} <= #{endTime} AND dur IS NOT NULL) cs LEFT JOIN callstack c ON cs.cookie = c.cookie AND c.name LIKE 'H:CJTHREAD_CJThreadSetName %'

select p.pid as processId, p.name as processName from callstack as cs left join thread as th on th.id = cs.parent_id left join process as p on th.ipid = p.ipid where cs.name LIKE 'H:CJTHREAD_CJThread%' AND cs.name NOT LIKE 'H:CJTHREAD_CJThreadSetName%' and NOT (( cs.ts + cs.dur < (#{startTime} + #{offset})) OR ( cs.ts > (#{endTime} + #{offset}) )) GROUP BY p.pid;
